name: Pokémon League
lines:
Only Trainers who have collected all eight Gym Badges
may go beyond this point.
Please permit us to evaluate your worthiness, Trainer.

Trainer!
Believe in yourself and your Pokémon, and go forth!

Due to Steven’s absence, the doors
to the Pokémon League are closed.
We apologize for the inconvenience and
thank you for your patience in waiting.
